notes: MNN-Pocket-0.3B_qualcomm_npu_ekv2048.litertlm of litert-community/MNN-Pocket-0.3B: taobao-mnn/MNN-Pocket-0.3B (Apache-2.0) as a static-range-quantized LiteRT-LM file for the Qualcomm HTP that the phone compiles at engine creation (on-device JIT); the rotary-position ranges of its aux graphs are raised to the whole 2,048-token cache. Added 2026-11-07 (Hub commit d95e1d8d); main 6ea52447 at the read, 374213768 B, sha256 e8af457e3d2840a1c5b35f66e7e8bf17d1c88212608f2ec0c374ef01966060a0. Measured 2026-11-07 on a Galaxy S26 in the runs r9 (GSM8K-100 through the Android wheel) and r12 (the v0.19.1 tag build: speed, the identity check). LiteRT-LM 0.19.1's CPU backend does not open the file; the Pixel 11 Pro's NPU was not run (the Google Tensor compiler plugin refuses more than one partition in on-device compile, read in LiteRT's source).
quantization: static-range quantized for the Qualcomm HTP (npu_export at litert-torch 6d4c622): int8 weights (one scale per output channel) with 16-bit integer activations; KV cache 2,048 tokens; prefill signature 128; no compiled NPU code (the phone compiles it at engine creation); model type qwen2p5
